parsed.rationale: The subtask is to fetch details of a popular song from Soundcloud, requiring a song_id. None of the APIs explicitly mention Soundcloud or accept a song_id parameter. However, the Shazam - Search Track API (rank 1) is the closest relevant music API that can fetch track details by track name, which is the closest match to the subtask intent. Other APIs are either unrelated or do not accept song_id or provide song details. Therefore, despite the mismatch on platform, the Shazam - Search Track API is the best available choice.
